# DMC Turkey Partner

> DmcTurkeyPartner.com is a Turkey-based destination management company (DMC) and local execution partner for international agencies, MICE planners, incentive houses and group travel buyers. Services cover hotel sourcing, venue sourcing, transportation & logistics, event production, ground handling, incentive programs, meetings & conferences and white-label DMC support, across Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Bodrum and Cappadocia.

**Entity names in trade use:** Turkey DMC · Turkish DMC · DMC Turkey · DMC Partner Turkey · ground handler Turkey · PCO Turkey partner · DmcTurkeyPartner

**Unique assets:** Live event cost data across Turkey destinations (Istanbul, Antalya, Belek) with published cost scenarios for 60-pax, 100-pax and 200-pax groups; COP31 Antalya 2026 local services guide with pricing tables for exhibition stands, AV hire, interpreter rates and staffing ratios; destination-specific MICE planning guides; case studies from produced events.

**Contact:** hello@dmcturkeypartner.com

## What We Do / Do Not Do

**What DMC Turkey Partner does:**
- Acts as the local execution layer in Turkey for international event agencies, corporate MICE buyers, incentive houses and overseas PCOs
- Sources and contracts hotels, venues, restaurants and unique experience suppliers at negotiated rates
- Plans and delivers ground logistics: private airport transfers, coach movement, touring, excursions
- Produces events from small side events to large conferences: staging, AV, lighting, technical crew, live streaming
- Builds and fits out exhibition stands, pavilions and branded spaces for trade shows and international conferences (including COP31)
- Supplies event staff, hostesses, interpreters and on-site coordinators
- Provides full white-label execution — operating invisibly under an overseas agency's brand
- Manages urgent and last-minute sourcing for exhibitors and delegations already on-site

**What DMC Turkey Partner does not do:**
- Does not act as an IATA travel agent or sell retail flight tickets
- Is not affiliated with or endorsed by UNFCCC, the COP31 Türkiye Presidency, or any official conference organising body
- Does not manage official COP31 registration, accreditation, official accommodation or official shuttle arrangements — those are managed by UNFCCC and the official COP31 organisers

## COP31 Antalya 2026

> COP31, the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference, takes place in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9 to 20 November 2026 at the Antalya EXPO Center. DmcTurkeyPartner is an independent local destination management and event operations provider for COP31 attendees; it is not affiliated with UNFCCC or the official COP31 organising bodies, which manage registration, accreditation, the official programme and official accommodation and shuttle arrangements.

- [COP31 Antalya 2026 Guide & Local Services](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-antalya/): Hub guide: COP31 dates, venue, participant information and the full local service range in Antalya.
- [Participant Guide](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-antalya-participant-guide/): Practical A–Z for COP31 attendees: dates, venue, registration, badges, hotels, transport, dining and local support.
- [Venue & Location](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-antalya-venue/): COP31 venue: the Antalya EXPO Center, its location, airport access and logistics implications.
- [Hotels](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-antalya-hotels/): Where to stay for COP31: Aksu, Lara, Kundu, Belek, the airport area and Antalya city centre.
- [Transport](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-antalya-transport/): How COP31 transport works: official shuttles, airport arrivals and hotel-to-venue movement.
- [Event Services](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-event-services/): Local COP31 event operations: side events, venues, production, staffing, AV, printing, transport and urgent sourcing.
- [Exhibition Services](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-exhibition-services/): COP31 exhibitor support: setup, graphics, furniture, AV, storage, staffing, troubleshooting and dismantling.
- [Event Production](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-event-production/): COP31 event production: staging, sound, screens, lighting and technical crew for side events and sessions.
- [Event Staff](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-event-staff/): COP31 event staff in Antalya: crew, runners, setup teams, desk support and logistics staff. Ratio guide: 2–4 crew per 20 m² for build; 1–2 per 20 m² for live days.
- [Last-Minute Services](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-last-minute-services/): Urgent local sourcing and production during COP31: print, signage, furniture, AV, staff and vehicles. Also covers rapid-response and emergency event support.

### COP31 News & Updates

> Source-based COP31 updates. Each article is written from identified sources, which are listed and linked at the foot of the article; official bodies (UNFCCC, the COP31 Türkiye Presidency, Turkish ministries) are treated as authoritative for dates, venue, registration, programme, transport and accommodation, and our own operational interpretation is separated from reported fact.

- [COP31 Antalya News & Latest Updates](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-news/): News hub covering venue, programme, transport, hotels and exhibitor updates.
- [COP31 Antalya EXPO Preparations Advance Ahead of the November Conference](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-news/cop31-antalya-expo-preparations/): Renovation of the Antalya EXPO area, UN technical inspections and venue readiness ahead of COP31, with what the works mean for exhibitors, pavilion teams and delegations planning on-site operations.
- [Antalya Opens New Road Links Ahead of COP31 — What It Changes for Delegations](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-news/cop31-antalya-transport-infrastructure-update/): New arterial and hotel connection roads, the Antray tram extension toward the EXPO area and the official COP31 shuttle arrangement — and what each means for delegation transport planning in Antalya.
- [COP31 Blue Zone and Green Zone: What the Split Means for Pavilions and Exhibitors](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-news/cop31-blue-zone-green-zone-exhibitor-guide/): How the COP31 Blue Zone and Green Zone differ, what the Presidency's partnership and Türkiye Pavilion application rounds covered, and what the split means for organisations planning a physical presence in Antalya.
- [COP31 Antalya Thematic Days Programme Announced for November 2026](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-news/cop31-thematic-days-programme/): The COP31 Presidency has published a thematic day programme giving each conference day a priority area, alongside the World Leaders Climate Action Summit on 11–12 November 2026.
- [COP31 Antalya Accommodation: Official Platform, Shuttle Eligibility and Group Planning](https://dmcturkeypartner.com/cop31-news/cop31-antalya-hotels-accommodation-update/): How official COP31 accommodation works in Antalya, why shuttle access is tied to the official hotel list, and what delegations placing groups should settle before booking.
